notes.title: May 1, 2020 - v0.126 - Major AI Update! In-City Zombies, Wild Life
notes.content:
May 1, 2020 - v0.126 - In-City Zombies, WildLife and AI

This is a very long awaited Update to W.A.R  Let us explain why...
Because W.A.R Generates a City on the fly for new servers. When dealing with AI or Moving NPC Characters, there must be some sort of PathFinding or Navigation for a AI/NPC. Therefore because the environment is always different from server to server, The AI/NPC Navigation Generation Must be done after the Environment is Generated. 

In Otherwords, We cannot Pre-Bake, Or Pre-Make this type of navigation.   This results in a lengthy process when hosting Servers that utilize AI.  It also required a Large Amount of RAM 8-12GB

That is the prime reason why In-City AI/NPC Navigation was not incorporated until Now!. 

We have included some images of Generated Navigation in this update. In the Screenshots the Light Blue area is the "Walkable" area for an AI. 

Developer AI Generation Images : 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33392906/c39013f775d50f9c4111f70e1734fffed609b1b3.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33392906/19765bdf93fe582ef28d8275899d8e074f35151f.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33392906/ef0f7ae04d4f7330578eafbc5adbce898d26d106.png

Since W.A.R Also has 30 Story Enter-able SkySrapers... We did not want to limit the ability for AI or enter or get to the 30th floor of a sky scraper... 

So you can see from some of the Navigation Images the Multi-Floor Generation and Stairs Connecting them, to allow AI/NPC to walk around and enter buildings properly.

We are a very small team of 3, and through the course of the project we have not taken much time off over the last 3 years so this was a very big treat for us. 
I’m sure you all understand; however, I do not like to leave things stale for too long. 
We have been in full tilt since last week making more adjustments and getting the newest builds issues resolved.

 We have fully updated the Project to Unity 2019, and resolved all the errors in doing so. 
 The project is now fully under High Definition and as such graphics have been improved 10 fold. 
 RAM Usage has been HALFED if not more… Currently on the newest build while in game, im using approx. 8 – 10 GB of RAM depending on Spawned items, and city buildings. We also believe this will be lower on Client only instances, as all our tests are hosted servers so far.  This has come WAY down from 11-15 GIGS
 This will vary depending on what has spawned In the server and we have seen it peak to 10 GB
 The Total Project has been cleaned and is now a nice and Tidy 4-5GB Total in size, Requiring less Hard drive Space. 
 The new unity networking has made things a little more performance driven.

We have literally had to comb through the entire game, every object, texture, mesh, bundle, spawners, and rebuild the terrain in the last few weeks as some of these systems or items had problems with the new unity system, or there were better options now due to the upgrade.

What will happen moving forward?
We are looking at moving away from weekly updates, and having Monthly Updates on the 1st of every month. 
We are going to do this for a couple of reasons but mainly because


  We feel we will be able to better manage and resolve bugs or issues on a per build basis
  Doing a Monthly Update takes away some of the consistent pressure we are under. 
  Doing Monthly Updates will allow use to more robustly test newly added features and content
  Planning and Scheduling can better be maintained and due dates adhered too in this fashion rather than weekly. 
  Allowing us to have some sort of personal time. 



We are very proud to post some screenshots and a couple youtube video links of the improvements for you all to check out. Links and images will be at the bottom of this post. 

We are looking to have the new version live to you all the 1st of this month.

To those of you who are here and asked for keys, we will give out free keys to those who ask for beta testing on the 1st, so tell your friends!
